Quests
LegendArea names are the game’s own, as on the map opened with M in the game. Diamonds are entrances (cave mouths, stairs, portals, connecting passages): click one to go there. Where several floors share one picture, each door says which floor it leads to and a dashed line joins the two ends; thick ochre lines are stairs you can walk straight across. Purple marks bosses, yellow “!” quest characters, orange squares chests that give quest items, red ones monsters a quest asks you to defeat; orange diamonds are spawn points that can spawn a hero; each spawn place has one dot, coloured by the strongest monster it can bring (purple boss > orange hero > red ordinary). Click a red spawn point, an orange diamond or a boss to see the champions, heroes and bosses that can appear there, with their numbers, skills and drops on each difficulty. Grey see-through parts belong to a neighbouring teleport area: click to open that map; paler ones that cannot be clicked are areas you cannot walk to from here. Every entrance was tested in game (Google Play version): hollow dots are arrival points (where you land coming from elsewhere, not doors; marked “one-way” when there is no door back on this side); grey doors cannot be entered; red ones end the game (chapter ending); doors tagged “condition” open only once it is met: hover over the door, or tap “condition”, to read it. A few unused map pieces with no entrance in the game are left out.Compiled by 贴吧用户_0taRWey · Titan Quest Database 3.1.1 · Titan Quest names, texts and map images © THQ Nordic; unofficial fan-made reference, free, not for commercial use.
